name: Indus International
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro77): Judged on the evidence, the row is out. Its only record is one 2008 page titled 'Indus' (shv.com/investment/indus.html), filed under the firm's own 'Investment Partnerships' category (D6), whose text describes Indus International's January 2007 combination with MDSI into Ventyx. That category's text does not identify the position: the same 2008 category pairs 'Biovest', which the 1999 table lists as 'Biovest Partners, medical investment partnership, Distributed', with the unrelated Biovest International's company description.
